001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.MatchType;
004import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
005
006import java.util.List;
007
008public interface Match extends Spectatable {
009
010    /**
011     * Get the players of the match.
012     * @return The players of the match
013     */
014    List<Player> getPlayers();
015
016    /**
017     * Get the spectators of the match.
018     * @return The spectators of the match
019     */
020    List<Player> getSpectators();
021
022    /**
023     * Get the amount of wins needed to win the match.
024     * @return The amount of wins needed to win the match
025     */
026    int getWinsNeeded();
027
028    /**
029     * Get the ladder name of the match.
030     * @return The ladder name of the match, or null if not set
031     */
032    String getLadderName();
033
034    /**
035     * Get the ladder display name of the match.
036     * @return The ladder display name of the match, or null if not set
037     */
038    String getLadderDisplayName();
039
040    /**
041     * Get the unique id of the match.
042     * @return The match id, never null
043     * @since 2.4.0
044     */
045    default String getMatchId() {
046        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * Get the name of the arena the match is played in.
051     * @return The arena name, never null
052     * @since 2.4.0
053     */
054    default String getArenaName() {
055        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
056    }
057
058    /**
059     * Check whether the match is ranked.
060     * @return true if the match is ranked
061     * @since 2.4.0
062     */
063    default boolean isRanked() {
064        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * Get the type of the match.
069     * @return The match type, never null; {@link MatchType#UNKNOWN} for types added by a newer core version
070     * @since 2.4.0
071     */
072    default MatchType getMatchType() {
073        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * Get how long the match has been running.
078     * @return The duration in seconds
079     * @since 2.4.0
080     */
081    default int getDurationSeconds() {
082        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
083    }
084
085    /**
086     * Get the current round number.
087     * @return The current round number, 1-based
088     * @since 2.4.0
089     */
090    default int getCurrentRoundNumber() {
091        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
092    }
093
094}
